title: 菊花賞の後に・現実は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Kikuka Sho over, King Halo must face reality as the crowd hollers for Special Week and Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo laments her loss and her failure to be recognized, and doubts if she's really first-rate. But then, Kawakami Princess and a few others offer their encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing I've been with her the whole time, King Halo rests her head on my shoulder. We remain that way until her tears stop flowing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following my suggestion, she resolves to not strive for the approval of others but to become her own version of first-rate.
